toc.text: The Role of Physical Scoresheet Backups

en.content:
The Role of Physical Scoresheet Backups

While digital scoring is primary, international archery regulations recommend maintaining a physical paper scoresheet at each target butt as a secondary verification record and signature archive.

Generating Formatted Scoresheets

To print pre-filled scoresheets:

  1. Go to Tournament Dashboard > Reports > Scoresheets.
  2. Select the category or print for the entire range.
  3. Click Print Scoresheets.

Each sheet prints pre-populated with athlete names, target numbers (1A, 1B), category titles, and standard 6-end score grids.

The Dual-Record Signing Protocol

At the conclusion of the session, athletes and scorekeepers verify that the physical score numbers match the digital tablet tally and sign the bottom of the sheet.
